ValidationRule.description: The covered range has to run forward. Only checked once both ends are well formed, so the format rules report their own problem first.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( REGEX(Period_Start__c, "20\\d\\d-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])"), REGEX(Period_End__c, "20\\d\\d-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])"), VALUE( LEFT(Period_Start__c, 4) & MID(Period_Start__c, 6, 2) ) > VALUE( LEFT(Period_End__c, 4) & MID(Period_End__c, 6, 2) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Period End cannot be earlier than Period Start.
